mechanism: Unpositioned screen ACCEPT/DISPLAY with an exception phrase (`ACCEPT SG ON EXCEPTION ... END-ACCEPT`, legal Format 3 shape: AT and the exception brackets are independent) draws a generic COBOL0307 parse error (plus a spurious COBOLNET0901 on END-ACCEPT) instead of the named A.4.2 refusal COBOLNET1707, contradicting docs/CONFORMANCE.md A.4.2's claim that every screen source shape draws a named Error. Deliberate grammar cost recorded at CobolScreen.g4 screenTail (exception phrases bound to the positioning phrase to stop DISPLAY stealing an enclosing statement's arm).
repro: SCREEN SECTION. 01 SG. 05 SI1 PIC X TO WS-X. ... ACCEPT SG ON EXCEPTION DISPLAY "E" NOT ON EXCEPTION DISPLAY "N" END-ACCEPT. at --std 2002/2023 -> COBOL0307 unexpected 'ON' / 'NOT' + COBOLNET0901 'END-ACCEPT is a reserved word' (probe/acc2.cob); DISPLAY twin probe/dsp2.cob the same.
